name: Hypnosis
description: A swinging pocket watch slowly puts you into a trance while you play.

enabled.name: Enable Hypnosis
enabled.description: Show the pocket watch and build up the trance during levels.

watch-color.name: Watch Color
watch-color.description: Color of the watch case and chain.

swing-speed.name: Swing Speed
swing-speed.description: How fast the watch swings. 1.0 is one full swing every 2.4 seconds.

trance-time.name: Time to Full Trance
trance-time.description: Seconds you need to survive to reach the deepest trance.

camera-sway.name: Camera Sway
camera-sway.description: How much the screen drifts along with the watch at full trance. 0 turns it off.

music-glow.name: Music Glow
music-glow.description: The watch glows to the beat of the music.

suggestions.name: Hypnotic Suggestions
suggestions.description: Calm messages fade in as the trance gets deeper.
